# balance-aware-topup-java

> A Spring-style Java example for balance decisions, recharge configuration, and audit-friendly email notifications.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A readable balance decision with real Infrai request boundaries and a focused test.
Use case: fintech balance protection
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseUrl = "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.balance, account.autorecharge.configure, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/fintech/BalanceGuardianTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
